description: Hit it with whatever you're holding.
Lob a hunk of rebar. Surprisingly effective.

Scrubs debuffs out of an ally's system.
Radiant heal in a small area.
The only offensive prayer the Medic knows.
Arc lightning from the ceiling cables.
Overloads every cable in the block.
Pry a microchip out of their neck port.
Vanish like a crate off the manifest.
Hold the trigger, let it hum, let it go.
Melts a boot to the floor.
Punches through everyone in a line.
Hurl a hypo. Works every time. Mostly.
Flushes toxins, glitches and bad decisions.
Fermented something in a bottle. Lit.

Punch the ground, hit the line.

Channel a volt into the blade.
Profile the target; exposes weak points.
Lock them out of their own limbs.
Veil's favourite trick: delete their confidence.
Drops a static trap on the grid.

Bolts together a buzzsaw attack droid.
A hover-droid full of nanite gel.

A tesla-coil droid that throws lightning.

Freeze them in the seven-second gap.
Shove an ally to the front of the clock.

A war-frame projection stomps the area.

Blinding strobes: every nearby enemy's accuracy drops.

Jet onto the tallest perch in reach.

Hit everything adjacent, friend or foe.

Tag the target. Everything hurts more.

Vent the core. Everything adjacent burns.
Fill their head with static. Identity slips.

Tear an essence leak into the floor.
Drags a line of enemies in.
+20% damage per straight tile moved this turn (max x2).
Drags everyone in a 3-tile line two tiles closer.
Marks them unstable: walls hit twice as hard.

Save point. If you'd die (or when it expires), snap back.
Rip 60 CT out of an enemy.

Raise a tile two levels (occupant rides along).
Swap your tile — and whoever stands on it — with another.
Ink burning neon onto the map.

Silently repeats the last ability an ally used, on the same spot, for free.
Pull a fallen body's essence back into a glitching echo that fights for you, then fades.

Collect what they owe in soul coins.

Back to work! Nearby allies attack up.
A Queen-hymn that rattles the skull.
A hymn at a frequency that hurts.
Feeds on what makes you, you.
Corrupts a chunk of your memory.
